'''Tralee''' was a location on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] and the site of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Tralee Naval Base|base]]. It provided air cover for Navy troopers deployed from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Indomitable]]'' following an attack by [[the Faceless]] on a [[DynaCorp]] refinery in [[Grande Hyet]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Tralee was itself [[Terrorist attacks on Esseles|attacked]] shortly thereafter.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Tralee|Tralee]] is a large coastal town in [[Wikipedia:County Kerry|County Kerry]], [[Wikipedia:Republic of Ireland|Ireland]].
